title: ScanWatch - Unusual Heart Rhythm Signal
visual_summary: Smartwatch ECG trace flagging pulse irregular intervals during sleep.
narration_summary: Your watch detected an unusual heart rhythm signal. Stay calm and contact your provider for guidance.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Illustrates how sleep apnea stresses cardiovascular system.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Recommends sharing watch ECG recording with physician.
